title: Dream about a mall
content: I'm 17, I haven't been to a mall in a while and I've been abusing drugs lately. There's a common pattern in my dreams where usually I'm in a mall that's made up with segments of different malls that I've experienced. Usually the dreams include steps that are a little too hard to get up or a very scary escalator ride which could cost me my life and sometimes I do fall and then I wake up. This time I had a very normal dream where I was even on my phone chatting to friends and there was a feeling of missing out because I was in the mall for like half an hour.
